summary: Iter77 — tested NEW endpoint POST /api/rede-ia/qrcode/bind-port (bind subscriber to CTO port + auto-create Kanban ticket source='rede_ia_qr') + regressions. Backend: 12/13 passed (1 skipped because no public listing endpoint to fetch a single ticket — see notes). Validated: 404 unknown CTO, 404 unknown port, 409 CTO not approved, success path (port goes used + linked_via_qr=true + linked_by_user_name set + history 'bind_port' entry + ticket_id returned with tkt- prefix), 409 duplicate port. Regression: /qrcode/scan roundtrip (info→token→scan), invalid token rejected (400), /rede-ia/ctos GET, /bairros, /pendencies (smartolt_hints field present), /analyze LLM (real Claude returned report >30 chars in <90s), /api/connections reachable (no 5xx — did NOT PUT). Frontend mobile (390x844, /?cid=col-30aafc3c, anonymous incognito-style): home loads (Olá DIOGO Tecnico header), kebab menu opens, 'Ler QR Code da CTO' click opens scanner overlay with <video> element + dotted viewfinder + 'Permissão de câmera negada' (expected in headless) + close (✕) button. CollaboratorApp.js forcedCollabId fix from iter76 confirmed working. Bind form (data-testids bind-port-N / bind-name / bind-pppoe / bind-phone / bind-notes / bind-svc-instalacao|manutencao|troca_porta / bind-submit / qr-bind-success) only renders after a real QR is scanned (camera required) — testid presence verified by code review.

minor.issue: Could not locate a list endpoint exposing tickets created via bind-port for post-hoc verification (tried /lousa/tickets, /tickets, /lousa — none returned the ticket). Bind-port itself returns ticket_id, history confirms creation, and DB insert is in code; just regression-listing was skipped.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot E2E in headless because no camera. UI renders correctly (video tag + overlay) and react-zxing handles permission denial gracefully with message. Bind form testids present in source.

action_items: (Optional) Expose a list endpoint for tickets filtered by source=rede_ia_qr so QA can verify ticket persistence end-to-end without DB access.
(Optional) Consider making the bind form reachable for manual QA without camera (e.g., dev-only debug button that injects a mock scan result) — only for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: rede_ia.py bind_port: ticket subscriber_id falls back to str(uuid.uuid4()) when not provided — this creates an orphan client_id with no link to subscribers collection. Consider linking to or creating a Subscriber doc so the ticket has a real client to update later.

rede_ia.py bind_port: priority='alta' for manutencao and 'horario' for everything else — 'horario' is unusual; the lousa elsewhere uses 'normal'/'media'/'baixa'. Verify it matches lousa kanban filters.

rede_ia.py bind_port: there is no rollback. If db.tickets.insert_one fails after db.ctos.update_one succeeds, the port stays 'used' with no ticket. Wrap in a try/except that reverts the port update on ticket creation failure.
rede_ia.py file is now ~1000 lines and growing — splitting into rede_ia/ctos.py, rede_ia/qrcode.py, rede_ia/bairros.py would improve maintainability (file >700 lines threshold).

success_rate.backend: 92% (12/13, 1 skipped because of missing listing endpoint — not a functional failure)
success_rate.frontend: 100% rendering tests passed (camera-dependent E2E not testable in headless)

seed_data_creation: Reused approved CTOs from previous iterations. Test creates TEST_BairroIter77_<sigla> and TEST_BP_<sigla> bairros + one extra approved CTO if none had free ports. Subscriber names prefixed TEST_Sub_*.

Ticket is created with source='rede_ia_qr' and cto_id/cto_port/cto_vlan stamped into client_snapshot. /qrcode/scan regression OK. /api/connections must remain GET-only — do NOT PUT dummy keys. rca of the issue: No bugs found in the new bind-port flow.
